source.notes: arch-057 — composition-now as a typed parameter-domain K1 reduction. The mixer executes through the public K1 path (weighted_reduce over the parameter_block source domain): scores = query @ key_paramᵀ × scale (plain dot), then the admitted K1 MAP_NORMALIZE reducer (axis A13, reference-tier), then output = norm(scores) @ value_param. The three pinned normalizer variants map onto the closed map_normalize fields exactly: softmax = (EXP, p=1, map-then-norm); gelu_l2_norm = (GELU, p=2, map-then-norm); l2_norm_gelu = (GELU, p=2, norm-then-map). The parameter tokens are learned nn.Parameter bound as the K1 key/value roles. Verified against megatron/model/tokenformer.py @ 4d56c73f. The native/SDPA K1 anchors decline the non-softmax reducer; only the reference tier executes it (a native schedule is residual, pending a second client per the two-client physical-branch rule). Layer module: architectures/pattention.py.

params.axis: A13 score/reducer algebra: K1 MAP_NORMALIZE reducer (score_map EXP/GELU × Lp normalizer_p × map<->norm order), reference-tier admission
typed_operations: weighted_reduce (K1: dot score + map_normalize reducer over parameter_block)

coverage.notes: Layer parity vs the pinned Pattention module across all three normalizer variants and a non-unit scale in tests/test_architectures_pattention.py, now through the public K1 weighted_reduce (map_normalize reducer); parameter-token gradients flow through the contraction. The descriptor validation and the reference-only decline contract are covered in tests/test_k1_provider_decline.py. NOT claimed (sweep blockers): the model-replacement role (Pattention substituting for QKV/output projections and the MLP), parameter-token construction/reparameterization, and any claim that one attention contraction equals MLP or MoE.
